meta.notes: One row per metro branch opening (FDIC code 711) or closing (721), oldest first. Mergers, sales and moves are not listed. bank_name is the bank's name on the event date; branch_name is as FDIC records it (often capitals). Left out: towns outside the metro that FDIC filed under a metro county by mistake (Rocky Mount, VA is in Franklin County (51067), not Franklin city; Appomattox, VA is in Appomattox County (51011), not Franklin city; Jacksonville, NC is in Onslow County (37133), not Camden County).
